title.narrative: Annual Output Results
Output Indicator

comment.narrative: 1.1 Target achieved. SAISE IT network infrastructure upgraded in a timely and efficient manner. 1.2 Target achieved. SAISE exceptionally performed during both first and second rounds of the 2020 Presidential Elections, as attested by the preliminary statements of the OSCE/ODIHR mission. 2.1 N/A 2.2 Target achieved.Campaign on informing citizens on the voting process during the COVID-19 pandemic successfully implemented reaching more than 100,000 indirect beneficiaries; 3.1 Target achieved. Technical support for the ongoing maintenance of the “Financial Control” module provided in a timely and efficient manner, contributing to the decrease of bugs and errors in the system. 3.2 N/A 4.1 Target exceeded. The Project succeeded to establish and facilitate the Election Partners Platform aimed at improving the dialogue and exchange of information with the international community on election issues and challenges. A total of six (6) meetings have been organized on a by-weekly basis with participation of more than 50 representatives from 45 national and international institutions (CEC, CCET, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and European Integration, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Health and Social Protection, donors and embassies).

2.1. Development and support of curriculums addressed to schools – finalized /Pending approval of the MoEDU 3.1. Update of the functionalities of the Financial Control Module – Pending finalization 3.2 Developed the GAP Analysis, Roadmap and CEC internal regulations for the reformation of the CEC Economic and Financial Department – Finalized 4.1 Organization of Quarterly Election Partners’ Platform meeting and secretariat for these – delivered/ongoing 5.1. Needs assessment and curricula on electoral education in universities - Finalized 5.2 Training and awareness raising activities to enhance the knowledge on inclusive democratic and electoral processes for youth and women wings of political parties – Finalized 6.1. Concept of a dedicated civic engagement campaign targeting pro-active youth currently residing abroad - Finalized 6.2 Support the implementation of the CEC Communication Strategy 2020-2023 - Finalized 7.1 Assessment of a total of 1206 polling stations across the country for the accessibility criteria in public institutions and elaborations of recommendations to improve these - Finalized 7.2 Guide for LPA’s dedicated to social inclusion of people with disabilities - Finalized
